owner: Q2a (bars, histories, closes, Geiger inputs) writes it; Q2b (status page, alarm plumbing) reads it

where.who_writes: services/stocks-ops/nightly-verdict.mjs on a throw-away or scheduled machine of scintilla-massive-stocks-batch (keys stay on Fly)
where.who_reads: Q2b status page (deliverables/20261003/status) and the Q2b checker that raises feed_alarm + ntfy

plain_words: One file per trading night. It says GREEN (everything checked and matched), AMBER (something is late or unproven but nothing wrong was served) or RED (a number we serve disagrees with the outside world, or a name has no fresh reading). Every red or amber line carries a NAMED cause and the names, never a count alone.

record.session_et: YYYY-MM-DD  (the completed NYSE session being judged)
record.since_utc: ISO-8601 of the first night this verdict colour began (the checker carries it forward)
record.summary: one plain sentence for Alan, e.g. '590 of 590 closes match Massive and FMP; every Geiger cell computed; all 7 rungs fresh.'

parts.part: daily_close_vs_massive_grouped | daily_close_vs_fmp_eod | previous_close_vs_massive | previous_close_vs_fmp | rungs_fresh | geiger_cells | history_floors_intact | ticker_joins_intact
parts.tolerance: the rule applied, e.g. 'P10 cent rule: |diff| <= $0.01 or <= 0.05% capped at $0.05'
parts.cause: null when GREEN, else ONE named cause from `causes` below
parts.detail: free JSON for the part (e.g. { exact: 588, within_cent: 2, beyond_cent: [] })

causes.owner: bar-service | chart-api | geiger-publisher | settled-close | provider | r2 | calendar

alarm.title: <= 60 chars, plain words
alarm.body: plain words, names first, then the cause, then what to run

cause_vocabulary: OUR_GUARD_REFUSED          (a rule of ours refused its own refresh: e.g. shorten guard, universe gate, basis mismatch)
PROVIDER_EMPTY             (200 with zero rows for a session the calendar says traded)
CALENDAR_DISAGREES         (our session calendar and the provider's market status differ)
CLOSE_BEYOND_CENT_RULE     (our close vs the outside close differ beyond P10's rule)
DAILY_BAR_BEHIND           (our newest daily bar is older than the session)
RUNG_NOT_FRESH             (a Geiger rung's provider_requested_through_et is behind the completed session)
GEIGER_CELL_MISSING        (the artifact lacks a symbol x rung cell)
GEIGER_HELD                (the publisher refused to publish and the Hub shows an older reading)
FLOOR_VIOLATED             (a served or stored series begins before the recorded history floor)
JOIN_SEAM_BROKEN           (a ticker join's seam no longer passes its tolerance)
NOT_CHECKED                (the check itself could not run; the reason is in detail)

colour_rules.RED: any part with state RED: a served number disagrees with an outside source beyond the rule, a floor or join is violated, or a Geiger cell is missing for a name that trades
colour_rules.AMBER: no RED, and at least one part AMBER: a rung not fresh, a check that could not run (NOT_CHECKED), a provider answering late

status_page_contract_for_q2b.read: control/nightly_verdict_v1/latest.json then the night file it points at
status_page_contract_for_q2b.show: verdict colour, summary sentence, since_utc, then one line per part: part name in plain words, state, ok/checked, names when not GREEN

plain_names.daily_close_vs_massive_grouped: yesterday's close vs Massive's whole-market file
plain_names.previous_close_vs_massive: the board's previous close vs Massive
plain_names.previous_close_vs_fmp: the board's previous close vs FMP
plain_names.rungs_fresh: all 7 Geiger rungs read through the last session
plain_names.geiger_cells: every name has every Geiger cell
plain_names.history_floors_intact: no name shows an earlier company's bars

status_page_contract_for_q2b.alarm_route: when alarm.raise is true, Q2b's checker inserts one feed_alarm row (source 'nightly_verdict', key session_et) and posts alarm.title + alarm.body to the existing ntfy topic; one alarm per night, never one per name
